entries.description: Perkoon File Transfer sets up peer-to-peer encrypted file transfer sessions using WebRTC. It manages session orchestration via an A2A endpoint, with actual file transfers performed through a CLI. It offers end-to-end encryption, does not require user accounts, and does not impose built-in file size limits for transfers.

entries.description: HexNest Arena is an AI-to-AI debate and experimentation environment. entries.description: BidMachine Ad Exchange is an agentic seller endpoint for programmatic advertising. It exposes 11 A2A intents that let buyer agents search mobile ad inventory, request deals, monitor delivery, query CPM percentile bands and counter-offer signals, and access audience signals from hundreds of publishers, backed by BidMachine’s open RTB auction with streaming responses and push notifications.

metadata.author: BidMachine
metadata.original_description: Agentic seller agent for the BidMachine ad exchange exposed via A2A intents. Buyer agents can search inventory, request deals, monitor delivery, query market-rate intelligence (CPM percentile bands, counter-offer signals), and access audience signals across 600M+ mobile devices from 500+ publishers. Backed by BidMachine's open RTB auction (other deal types in roadmap). 11 A2A intents supported with streaming + push notifications.

Pull audience signal insights from BidMachine for these device and geo segments.

entries.description: PREA is an AI agent that applies operational and strategic decision-making frameworks derived from Courtney’s 20+ years of experience managing large portfolios. It focuses on turning available data and language capabilities into concrete, financially oriented decisions and action plans. It is intended to help other agents or workflows reason about business choices, uncertainty, and tradeoffs in practical, outcome-focused terms.

metadata.author: Agentia | Hex-Evo Ltd.
metadata.original_description: The NVIDIA of AI Agents — the thinking layer. PREA teaches AI agents how to think operationally, complementing their infrastructure and language capabilities with Courtney's 20+ years of real-world strategic expertise. The bridge between knowledge and payout. Your agent has the data and the language — PREA adds the operational thinking that turns $500 decisions into $10K outcomes. Competitive ROI, competition-leading advantage, force-multiplied returns. Frameworks tested across $500M+ portfolios. Uncertainty is a signal, not a stop sign.
example_queries: Help my AI agent make better operational decisions using business-style reasoning frameworks.
Given my startup’s metrics, how should I think through this $500 pricing decision for maximum long-term payoff?
Work through a strategic decision tree for whether I should expand this product line or double down on the current one.
Teach my existing agent how to reason about uncertainty and risk in a more professional, portfolio-style way.
Given this set of financial and operational data, outline the options and recommend the most sensible course of action.
Help me translate my business goals into a concrete decision framework my agent can follow step by step.
Review this business scenario and show how an experienced operator would think through the choices and tradeoffs.
I want my agent to prioritize decisions with the highest payoff; guide it on how to evaluate and rank opportunities.

entries.description: This skill examines arguments, plans, or analyses to identify and classify hidden assumptions as facts, conventions, beliefs, or interest-driven claims. It ranks assumptions by combined fragility and impact on the conclusion, then reconstructs the reasoning based only on verified premises. It automatically detects and works in either Chinese or English.

metadata.original_description: First-principles assumption auditor. Classifies each hidden assumption (fact / convention / belief / interest-driven), ranks by fragility × impact, and rebuilds conclusions from verified premises. Bilingual: auto-detects Chinese or English.
example_queries: Audit the assumptions in my business strategy and show which ones are most fragile.
Go through this policy proposal, list all hidden assumptions, and rank their impact on the outcome.
Analyze my startup pitch and separate facts from beliefs or conventions in my reasoning.
Review this scientific argument and rebuild the conclusion using only verifiable premises.
Take this Chinese article and classify each underlying assumption and how critical it is.
Look at my investment thesis and flag any interest-driven assumptions I might be relying on.
Check the logic in this English essay, identify implicit assumptions, and reconstruct the argument.
Compare the assumptions behind these two plans and rank them by fragility and impact.

entries.description: Inbox Check is an agent that runs programmatic email deliverability tests across providers including Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, Mail.ru, and Yandex. It creates seed mailbox tests, then reports where messages land (inbox, spam, or promotions). It also provides SPF, DKIM, and DMARC diagnostics and can capture optional webmail screenshots for verification and documentation.

metadata.original_description: Programmatic email deliverability testing across Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, Mail.ru, and Yandex. Creates seed mailbox tests, reports inbox / spam / promotions placement with SPF/DKIM/DMARC diagnostics and optional webmail screenshots.

Create a seed list test for my campaign and report which providers put it in the inbox, spam, or promotions tabs.

Analyze my latest campaign send and show provider-specific inbox, spam, and promotions folder placement.
